messages:
eli: FYI — production deploys from main are failing in CI. GitHub Actions job `deploy-prod` is hitting 403 from Redwood API when posting a deploy. Logs below, started ~2025-03-10 02:10 UTC. Need hotfix.

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/deploys -H \"Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN\" -d '{\"model\":\"prod-llama\",\"version\":\"v1.2.3\"}'\nHTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{\"error\":{\"code\":403,\"message\":\"insufficient_scope: missing:inference.deploy.write\"}}
```

eli: We pinned the repo secret `CI_TOKEN` ages ago (was a PAT copied from a human) — I think it might have been invalidated by the RBAC change rolled yesterday. Job uses the token directly from secrets.

devops-bot: ALERT: 5+ 403s detected on route /v1/deploys in prod between 2025-03-10T02:09:00Z and 2025-03-10T02:14:00Z :rotating_light:

sophie: @eli thanks — can you confirm whether that secret is a long-lived personal token or a service-account token? Also paste the GH Actions snippet that does the deploy (mask sensitive bits).

eli: Snippet below (sanitized):
```
- name: Deploy to prod
  env:
    CI_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CI_TOKEN }}
  run: |
    curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/deploys \
      -H \"Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN\" \
      -d '{\"model\":\"prod-llama\",\"version\":\"${{ env.VERSION }}\"}'
```
It is definitely the repo secret, created years ago by someone on the infra team. No OIDC flow.

jason: Rolling context — yesterday we tightened service-account RBAC and introduced least-privilege roles. The old broad role that many long-lived tokens used was removed; CI should use the new `ci-deployer` service account role which requires tokens to include scope `inference.deploy.write`. We recommended moving to ephemeral tokens via OIDC for GH Actions.

eli: Okay that matches. Is there a quick mitigation so deploys don't block? Can we temporarily allow the old token while we migrate?

maria: Short answer: we shouldn't re-enable broad long-lived tokens in prod. We can provide a short-lived emergency token for the repo (1h) scoped to only deploy permissions, and help you move to OIDC. My recommended steps (short):
- create a dedicated service account `ci-prod-deployer` with least privilege
- mint a token with lifetime_seconds=3600 and scopes=["inference.deploy.write","models.read"]
- update the GH Action to request the short-lived token (or use OIDC)

sophie: Creating ticket and escalation for platform to add a temporary allowlist and push docs. TICKET-4321 created. @ticket-bot please attach.

ticket-bot: Created TICKET-4321: "prod CI deploys — migrate repo secret to scoped service-account tokens" assigned to @jason, priority P1, due 2025-03-10T06:00:00Z.

sophie: Maria, can you drop the exact curl we can run to mint the emergency token? I'll coordinate with eli for rotation.

maria: Use admin creds (example below). Replace $ADMIN_TOKEN with an admin API key that has service_account:manage.
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/service_accounts/ci-prod-deployer/tokens \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"lifetime_seconds\":3600,\"scopes\":[\"inference.deploy.write\",\"models.read\"]}' | jq -r '.access_token'
```
Then set the repo secret to the returned token and mark it for rotation after 1h.

eli: I temporarily replaced the repo secret with a 1h token created by infra and retried a deploy — success! Logs: "201 Created" and deploy proceeded :shipit:.

jason: I'll put a short-lived policy in place so that the long-lived token is blocked for prod in 24h if not rotated. Also adding an automated check to fail CI if the token lifetime & scopes are not compliant.

maria: Follow up: security will schedule a sweep to rotate any remaining long-lived tokens used in CI across orgs; we'll add a new doc in the infra runbook showing how to mint tokens and configure GH Actions to request them. :lock:

sophie: Summary / resolution: TICKET-4321 — root cause: RBAC hardening removed broad role used by an old long-lived repo token. Short-term mitigation: minted scoped 1h token for repo and restored deploys. Long-term: migrate to OIDC/ephemeral tokens and enforce token lifetime checks. Assigned action items to @jason (infra policy + automation) and @eli (verify other repos). Closing thread; moving details into TICKET-4321. :white_check_mark:
